battle.name: 淮漢之戰
battle.brief: 公元494年，北魏太和十八年孝文帝拓跋宏遷都洛陽後興兵南下，與南齊在淮水下游的壽陽、歷陽、瓜步一線及漢中梁州方向同時交兵，淮南幾度拉鋒又失，江淮邊境淪為長期拉鋸。卡面投石機是三世紀羅馬扭力式拋射機，五世紀漢地攻城早已改用槓桿配重式拋石車與撞車、雲梯配合，卡面器械不在此役現場。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是北魏與南朝齊在江淮邊境與漢中方向同時展開的邊境戰役，發生於北魏太和十八年（494）、南齊永泰元年。開戰之時，北魏已於同年秋遷都洛陽，國策由平城時代的守邊轉為向中原與江淮推進；南齊則在明帝蕭鸞即位之初清洗宗室與權臣，前線由豫州刺史與徐州刺史分守淮南要地。交戰體系一邊是北魏的洛陽中樞加上沿邊鎮戍與州郡兵戶的體系，一邊是建康朝廷的州郡兵與徵發諸軍。爭奪的重點是兩條水路：一是淮水下游，自壽陽、合肥到歷陽、瓜步，控淮即可窺伺建康；二是漢水上游的梁州，即漢中、劍閣一線，控此則可南下巴蜀、威脅雍益。北魏方面以騎兵為傳統主力，中原漢人軍戶與歸附部族編成的步軍逐步加入；孝文帝同期推行漢化，禁用胡服騎射，試圖把軍隊改造成以步騎配合、依城池屯駐的南朝式體制。南齊方面則倚長江水網與江淮城防，步卒用強弩與長槊，騎兵規模遠小於北魏，攻城倚賴撞車、雲梯、巢車與拋石車。整場戰爭不是一次會戰，而是一條以渡口與城池為節點的長期拉鋸；雙方都明白，任何一方在淮上站穩，都意味著把戰線推到對方門戶之下。
countriesEn: This war was a set of frontier operations fought at the same time by Northern Wei and the Southern Qi court along the Jiang-Huai border and in the direction of Hanzhong, in the eighteenth year of the Tahe era of Northern Wei (494), the first year of Yongtai in Southern Qi. When it began, Northern Wei had already moved its capital to Luoyang in the autumn of that same year, and state policy had turned from the defensive posture of the Pingcheng era into a push toward the central plains and the Jiang-Huai region; Southern Qi, on the other hand, had just seen Emperor Ming of Qi, Xiao Luan, take the throne and was engaged in purging the imperial clan and the powerful ministers at court, while the front line was held by the Inspector of Yu Province and the Inspector of Xu Province in the strategic towns of the Huai region. On the Wei side the structure was the Luoyang centre together with the network of frontier garrisons and the military households of the commanderies; on the Qi side it was the provincial troops of Jiankang together with levies drawn from the commanderies. The object of the fighting lay on two lines of movement. The first was the lower Huai: Zhoushan, Hefei, Liyang and Guabu, for whoever held the Huai could look in on Jiankang. The second was the upper Han: Liangzhou, that is Hanzhong and Jiange, from which one could go down into Bashu and threaten Yong and Yi. Northern Wei still had cavalry as its traditional strength, and infantry drawn from Han Chinese military households and from submitted tribes was being folded in; Emperor Xiaowen was simultaneously pushing Sinicisation, banning Hu dress and Hu-style riding and shooting, and trying to remake the army into a southern-style force of combined infantry and cavalry garrisoned in towns. Southern Qi, by contrast, leaned on the river network of the Yangtze and on the fortifications of the Jiang-Huai, with foot soldiers using heavy crossbows and long spears, a cavalry far smaller than Wei's, and a siege train of battering rams, siege ladders, observation towers and stone-throwers. The whole war was not a single battle but a long grind strung along a chain of fords and walled towns, and both sides understood that whoever stood firm on the Huai would be pressing at the other's door.
people: 推動這場戰爭的是北魏孝文帝拓跋宏。他早年以禪位為名迫太上皇拓跋弘退位並不久將其毒殺，隨後把國家重心移出平城，太和十八年九月遷都洛陽，同年冬天又下詔禁用胡服，改用漢式衣冠；他親自籌劃並主導的南伐，是讓北魏新制度在南方取得實戰驗證的一步，瓜步之役的無功而返在他晚年仍是難解之痛。前線主將多由鎮南將軍、冠軍將軍一類宿將擔任，楊津便是北魏鎮南將軍中的代表人物；梁州方向的漢中戰線由魏軍另路進取，與洛陽方向相互配合。南齊方面，明帝蕭鸞在永泰元年即位，藉誅除蕭宗等宗室與權臣鞏固帝位，對北魏採守勢，遣重兵屯淮陰、盱眙、壽陽一線，並由大將曹虎等將領率大軍北上赴援，以宗室與州郡將領分守瓜步、歷陽等城，防線一旦被突破便直抵建康。戰局中真正決定節奏的，還有留在洛陽的淮南王拓跋徵：他密謀在魏主南征之際於京師作亂，事敗被殺，消息傳到淮上軍中，北魏軍心大動，兵鋒遂止。齊魏兩國往來的使節，則在戰爭之外維持了一條勉強的管道：議和、互市、彼此觀察，戰場上的勝負與談桌上的接觸同時進行。
peopleEn: The man who drove this war was Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei, Tuoba Hong. Early in his reign he forced the retired emperor Tuoba Hong to abdicate in name and had him killed soon afterwards, and then he moved the centre of the state out of Pingcheng: in the ninth month of the eighteenth year of Tahe he transferred the capital to Luoyang, and in the winter of the same year he issued an edict banning Hu dress and ordering Han-style clothing. The southern campaign he planned and led himself was meant to test the new institutions of Wei in actual fighting in the south, and the futility of the Guabu expedition remained an unsolved puzzle for him in his last years. The field commanders were as a rule senior men holding posts such as General of the Southern Army or Champion General, and Yang Jin was a representative figure among the Wei generals of that kind; on the Liangzhou front the operations against Hanzhong were undertaken by a separate column in concert with the drive from Luoyang. On the Qi side Emperor Ming, Xiao Luan, took the throne in the first year of Yongtai and strengthened his position by putting members of the imperial clan and powerful ministers such as Xiao Zong to death, and he adopted a defensive posture towards Northern Wei: heavy troops were stationed along the line of Huaiyin, Xuyi and Zhoushan, and generals such as the commander Cao Hu led a great army north to meet the enemy, while princes and provincial commanders were set to hold towns such as Guabu and Liyang, since a breach in that line would carry the war straight to Jiankang. What really decided the tempo of the campaign was the prince of Huainan, Tuoba Zheng, who stayed behind in Luoyang and plotted a rising in the capital while the emperor campaigned in the south; the plot was discovered and he was killed, and when the news reached the Wei army on the Huai the whole force was shaken and the advance stopped. Envoys passing between Qi and Wei kept a grudging channel open outside the fighting: negotiations, trade and mutual observation went on at the same time as the clashes in the field.
kits: 卡面這件投石機（Onager）是三世紀前後羅馬帝國的扭力式拋射機：以木架張緊的皮筋或繩索作動力，拋臂一次釋放，把石彈或陶罐甩向城牆，射程可達數百步，在羅馬的圍城戰中用來壓制城頭、破壞女牆。它與494年這場戰役相隔約七百四十年，並不在此役的現場：五世紀的漢地攻城另有一套器械體系，而且走的是另一條技術路線。與羅馬的扭力式不同，中國的拋石車採用槓桿配重，靠人力絞盤或槓桿把長臂掀到極限，末端的配重落下，臂端石彈拋出，射程更遠，但操作所需的絞索人數更多、體積更笨重；早在三國時曹真守陳倉便已用霹靂車破蜀軍，東晉南北朝時稱砲、飛石、拋石車的器械已是南方城池守備的常設。真正決定這場邊境戰爭走味的攻城器械是組合式的：撞車以木樑包鐵撞擊城門與女牆，雲梯供步兵登城，巢車與望樓供觀察與射擊，地道與壕溝用來削弱守軍，拋石車則用來砸擊城頭、逼守軍離開掩體。步戰兵器方面，南北朝雙方都已以強弩與長槊、刀為主幹：弩機以踏張或腰張蓄力，射程可數百步，齊軍據城時常以弩壓制魏軍的攻城器械與隊形；魏軍騎兵仍保有早期草原式的優勢，披掛具裝的戰馬給了騎兵在撞陣與追擊中更大的衝擊力，而考古上在河北承德一帶出土過四至五世紀的鐵蹄鐵，說明北方騎兵已普遍為戰馬裝蹄鐵，在泥濘的淮北冬春地面上行軍時尤其見效。步兵則以長槊結陣抵擋騎兵衝鋒，甲胄以札甲與皮甲為主，另有少量精甲護士隨王師出行。運輸與糧秣方面，兩國都靠運車、牛馬與沿途屯田就食，這條糧道往往比戰鬥本身更早斷裂。
kitsEn: The stone-thrower on the card is a torsion-powered siege engine of the Roman Empire of roughly the third century BC/AD: wooden frames with tightly stretched hide or sinew as its power source, the throwing arm released in a single motion to hurl stones or ceramic jars at a wall, with a range of several hundred paces, used in Roman sieges to batter the battlements and break the parapet. It stands about seven hundred and forty years away from the fighting of 494 and cannot have been present on this field: the siege train of the Chinese lands in the fifth century was a different system, and it followed a different line of technology. Unlike the Roman torsion engine, the Chinese stone-thrower used a lever with a counterweight, worked by a winch or lever crew to raise the long arm to its limit so that the weight at the rear end dropped and the stone at the arm's end was thrown; its range was greater, but the number of men needed to work the ropes was larger and the whole machine bulkier. As early as the Three Kingdoms period Cao Zhen used a thunder-stone engine to beat the Shu army at Chencang, and by the Eastern Jin and the Northern and Southern dynasties the machines called pao, feishi or paoshiche were standard equipment in the defence of southern cities. The siege engines that really shaped this frontier war were of the combined kind: battering rams with an iron-shod beam to strike gates and parapets, siege ladders for the foot to climb, observation towers and lookouts for watching and shooting, tunnels and ditches to undermine the defenders, and stone-throwers to smash the battlements and drive the garrison out of cover. In close combat the main arm of both northern and southern armies in this period was the heavy crossbow, the long spear and the sabre: the crossbow was cocked by foot or by the small of the bowman, could shoot several hundred paces, and the Qi troops manning the walls habitually used the crossbow to dominate the Wei siege train and the formations that came up to it; Wei cavalry still held the advantage of the early steppe, and armoured warhorses gave the horsemen far more weight in the charge and in pursuit, while iron horseshoes of the fourth to fifth century have been excavated around Chengde in Hebei, showing that northern cavalry were already fitting their horses with shoes in general, a matter of particular account on the muddy ground of the Huai north in late winter and early spring. The foot soldiers formed ranks of long spears to receive the cavalry charge, armour was chiefly of the lamellar and leather kinds, and a small number of heavily armoured guards accompanied the royal army. For transport and supply both states relied on wagons, draught animals and farming the land along the line of march, and that supply line was often broken before the fighting was.
tactics: 淮南與漢中兩條戰線的作戰方式並不相同。淮水下游是水網地帶：春夏水漲，淮水下游寬處可達數里，舟船是主要的運輸與渡河工具，兩軍都難以讓大隊騎兵一次過江，只能守住渡口與壽陽、歷陽、瓜步等節點，以小股舟師與游騎互相試探，再在枯水期搶奪渡場。北魏軍隊的另一個特點是速戰與避戰交替：孝文帝自洛陽出發，行程近兩千里，糧道沿汝南、潁川、淮水而北，一旦被斷就必須迅速回師或就地籌糧，所以魏軍的典型戰法是先以騎兵掠奪破壞，切斷淮南守軍的預警與糧秣，再在需要的渡口或空城強行渡過；當齊軍重兵集結時，魏軍又常主動退保，等待對方離開城池再重新接近。漢中方向則完全是山地的攻守：劍閣、沔陽之間的山道狹窄，車馬難行，攻方必須靠步軍沿山脊展開，用弩陣與長槊頂住守軍居高臨下的攻擊，糧秣靠人力背負與牛馬馱運，一場戰役的勝負往往在補給斷續數日之後才見分曉。守城一方在南齊的經驗是典型的多層防禦：城外築塹，壽陽這類重鎮則築壘，壘外再圍長塹，塹後置木柵，柵後列弩手，城中設飛樓、井欄與水竇，井欄與水竇的作用是在攻城者進塹時以弓箭與投擲物反覆打擊，同時兼作守軍的飲水來源。這種把水、箭、投射物與牆體結合起來的守城法，正是攻城方必須先用拋石車砸城頭、再用撞車破門的理由。雙方都清楚，勝敗不在一次衝鋒，而在誰能先把攻城器械推到城下，並保住自己的糧道與渡口。
tacticsEn: The two fronts, Huai and Hanzhong, were fought in quite different ways. The lower Huai was a country of water: the river spread in summer and spring, and in its wider reaches the Huai ran to several li across, so boats were the principal means of transport and of crossing. Neither army could get a large body of cavalry across at once; they could only hold the fords and the nodes of Zhoushan, Liyang and Guabu, probe each other with small flotillas and outriding parties, and seize fords in the low-water season. The Wei army had another characteristic, the alternation of the quick stroke with the avoidance of contact: Xiaowen set out from Luoyang on a march of close to two thousand li, with the supply route running north along Runan, Yingchuan and the Huai, and once that line was cut he had either to march back quickly or to live off the country where he stood. The typical Wei method was therefore to send the cavalry out to forage and destroy, cutting the Huai garrison's warning system and its supplies, and then to force the river at the ford or the empty town that was needed; when the Qi troops massed, the Wei would often retire deliberately and wait for them to leave their walls before coming in again. Hanzhong was in every respect a mountain war: the tracks between Jiange and Mianyang were narrow and impassable for wagons, and the attacker had to spread his foot soldiers along the ridge, holding the high ground with crossbow volleys and long spears against the descent of the defenders, while the food and the arrows went up the slope on human backs and on pack animals; the issue of such an operation was often decided only several days after the supply had been cut. The defence on the Qi side shows the layered pattern that Southern Qi had worked out: a ditch outside the wall, and for a fortress town like Zhoushan a double rampart with a long outer ditch, a stockade behind the ditch and crossbowmen behind the stockade, while inside the wall stood lookout towers, well-heads and water outlets, the last two serving both to shoot arrows and thrown stones at the enemy as it came down into the ditch and to supply the garrison with drinking water. This marriage of water, arrows, missiles and masonry is precisely why an attacking force had to break the battlements with stones first and only then work at the gate with a ram. Both sides understood that the issue was not settled by a single charge but by who could bring the heavy engines up to the wall first while keeping his own supply line and his fords.
data: 與這場戰役有關而可以寫入的數字大致如下。年代方面，北魏太和十八年即公元494年，南齊永泰元年；孝文帝遷都洛陽在該年九月，禁用胡服的詔令在同年十二月，翌年太和十九年（495）他再親率大軍南下，十月前後兵抵瓜步，隔淮與建康相望。淮水下游在汛期寬處可達數里，瓜步距建康城僅數十華里，自洛陽至瓜步的直線距離約八百公里，實際行軍近兩千里。兵員方面，文獻常以二十萬記南齊北上赴援之眾，以數十萬或百萬記北魏南征大軍，這類數目在史家中多被視為誇大之辭；就當時的運輸與徵發能力而言，實際參戰兵力當在數萬上下，而非數十萬。人口與兵源方面，《魏書·食貨志》記太和十年（486）天下計戶五百萬餘，折算人口逾一千萬，學者多認為戶籍有脫漏，實際人口遠低於此；南齊治下的江南在劉宋末年以來的戰亂與戶口流失之後，兵源主要靠荊、揚等人口稠密州郡徵發，總量不及北魏。器械與守城方面，壽陽、歷陽、瓜步一線的城牆與塹壕需要持續徵發工匠與役夫修整，一部拋石車每次拋射需要數十人操作絞盤，一支像樣的攻城大軍至少要同時維持數部這樣的器械，這就是為何淮南每一次攻防都動輒耗時數月。時間成本同樣可見：孝文帝南征在瓜步因舟船不得渡、軍中又生變亂而班師，兵力折耗與糧秣耗費自不待言；他於太和二十三年（499）正月病逝於谷城，距瓜步之役不到四年。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on this campaign are roughly as follows. As to dating, the eighteenth year of the Tahe era of Northern Wei is the year 494, the first year of Yongtai in Southern Qi; Xiaowen moved the capital to Luoyang in the ninth month of that year, the edict banning Hu dress came in the twelfth month of the same year, and in the following year, the nineteenth year of Tahe (495), he led a great army south again and reached Guabu around the tenth month, looking across the Huai at Jiankang. In its flood-season reaches the lower Huai was several li wide, Guabu lay only some tens of li from the city of Jiankang, and the direct distance from Luoyang to Guabu is about eight hundred kilometres, the march itself running to close to two thousand li. On numbers of men, the texts record twenty thousand times ten for the Qi army marching north to the rescue and tens of thousands or a million for Wei's southern host; historians generally treat such figures as exaggeration, and the transport and levy capacity of the time suggests that the real forces engaged were of the order of several tens of thousands rather than hundreds of thousands. On population and man-power, the Weishu in the chapter on food and the economy records that in the tenth year of Tahe (486) the households of the realm were counted at more than five million, which converts to a population of over ten million, though scholars hold that the registers were full of omissions and the true population was much lower; in the south, the Jiangnan under Qi had lost households through the wars and the flight of population since the end of the Liu Song, so its man-power was drawn chiefly from the thickly settled commanderies of Jing and Yang and was less in total than Wei's. On engines and defences, the walls, ditches and ramparts of the Zhoushan-Liyang-Guabu line needed craftsmen and labourers kept in constant employment, a single stone-thrower needed several tens of men working the winch for every throw, and a proper besieging army had to keep at least several such machines in action at once, which is why every attack and defence in the Huai region dragged on for months at a time. The cost in time is equally visible: Xiaowen's expedition was brought to a halt at Guabu because the boats could not be got across and because a rising broke out in the army, and the wastage of men and stores needs no further comment; he died of illness at Gucheng in the first month of the twenty-third year of Tahe (499), less than four years after Guabu.
cause: 打起來的原因有多層。表面上，這是南齊與北魏在江淮邊境兩條戰線同時收緊的結果。孝文帝在平城定都時，北魏的南進有限；遷都洛陽之後，朝廷靠近了前線，卻也靠近了南方王朝實際控制的區域，漢中（梁州）、淮南與襄陽一帶的歸屬，就從模糊的緩衝地變成必須處理的具體問題。制度上的推力更大：孝文帝在太和十八年推行漢化，禁用胡服、鼓勵漢人穿漢衣、改官制與姓氏，這套改制的安全前提是北魏在南方的邊境必須穩得住；一旦淮南失守，改制中的鮮卑貴族將失去退路。因此南伐在北魏內部同時具有守邊與立新制的雙重意義：既是為洛陽新都爭取屏障，也是要在實戰中證明漢化後的軍隊仍然能打。對南齊而言，因果方向相反：明帝蕭鸞在永泰元年清洗宗室、鞏固皇位，朝廷對外力主持重，一旦北魏壓上來，必須靠既有的長江防線與淮南城防把戰線釘在原地，否則建康門戶洞開。南齊在這一年還要分心處理內部的諸王與州郡勢力，無法集中全部資源應對北魏，於是邊境只能以守禦、屯田、築壘的方式拖住對手。雙方的真正分歧因此不在某一場會戰，而在誰能先把對手拖進一場消耗戰：北方有馬與人力，南方有城池與江防。
causeEn: There were several layers to the reasons for fighting. On the surface it was the result of both sides tightening two lines at once along the Jiang-Huai border. While the capital stood at Pingcheng, Northern Wei's advance south was limited; once the court was moved to Luoyang it sat close to the front, but also close to the zones actually controlled by the southern dynasty, and the ownership of Hanzhong (Liangzhou), the Huai region and the Xiangyang area changed from a vague buffer into a concrete question that had to be settled. The institutional push was greater still: in the eighteenth year of Tahe Xiaowen carried through the Sinicisation, banning Hu dress, urging Han Chinese to wear Han clothing and changing titles and surnames, and the precondition of the whole reform was that Wei's southern frontier must hold; if the Huai region were lost, the Xianbei aristocracy of the reform would lose its retreat. The southern campaign therefore carried a double meaning inside Northern Wei: it was at once a shield raised for the new capital at Luoyang and a practical demonstration, in the field, that an army after Sinicisation could still fight. For Southern Qi the direction of causation ran the other way: Emperor Ming, Xiao Luan, was purging the clan and consolidating his throne in the first year of Yongtai, the court was on guard against outside force, and once Northern Wei pressed in it was the existing line of the Yangtze and the fortified towns of the Huai that had to nail the front in place, or the door of Jiankang would stand open. In that same year Qi also had to deal with the princes and the provincial powers inside its own borders and could not concentrate every resource against Wei, so the frontier could only be held by defence, by tilling the land and by raising ramparts. The real disagreement between the two states was therefore not over any single battle but over who could drag the other into a war of attrition: the north had horses and men, the south had cities and the river.
impact: 這場拉鋸留下的痕跡，多數不在戰果而在體制與地盤。第一是北魏南進節奏的確立：經過494至495年淮南的僵持與瓜步的無功而返，孝文帝的漢化改革得以在沒有立刻崩潰的情況下繼續推進，北魏軍隊逐步從草原騎兵為主的樣貌轉為倚重沿邊城鎮與中原州郡的步軍與屯田，這條路後來在南朝北邊演成北魏與南朝在淮漢兩線長期對峙的格局。第二是南齊防線的定形：壽陽、歷陽、瓜步、鍾離、義陽這一串城被固定為南朝北面的屏障，淮南守軍的編制、軍屯與城防從此年年修整，壽陽後來在侯景之亂時淪陷、鍾離在梁天監六年（507）由韋叡創全功拒魏，都可以看出這套防線在494年之後被打磨得何等細密。第三是梁州（漢中）線的長期化：漢中在南北之間反覆易手，497年有南陽之戰，503年魏軍攻下義陽、逼近梁州，說明兩國在漢中與襄陽一線的爭奪不是一次性的插曲，而是持續了半個世紀以上的結構性對抗。器械技術上，這幾十年的攻城實戰也把中國式的拋石車、撞車與雲梯推到更成熟的位置，攻城從此更多依靠器械組合與圍城消耗，而不是單次野戰。最後是外交上的反覆：齊魏之間在兵戎相見的同時仍有使節往來、互市與議和，邊界線是靠雙方都不願承擔全勝的代價而維持的，這種打而不破的狀態，正是五世紀江淮邊境的基本樣貌。
impactEn: The marks left by this grinding campaign lie mostly in institutions and in territory rather than in the tally of victories. The first is the fixing of the pace of Wei's southern advance: after the stalemate in the Huai region in 494 and 495 and the fruitless business at Guabu, Xiaowen's Sinicising reforms were able to go forward without collapsing at once, and the Wei army gradually changed from a shape dominated by steppe cavalry into one leaning on the foot soldiers and the military farms of the frontier towns and of the central commanderies; that road later became the pattern of a long Northern Wei-Southern dynastic confrontation along both the Huai and the Han lines. The second is the fixing of the Qi defensive system: the chain of towns Zhoushan, Liyang, Guabu, Zhongli and Yiyang was set as the northern shield of the southern dynasty, and the dispositions, the garrison farms and the fortifications of the Huai were repaired year by year thereafter; the fact that Zhoushan was later lost during the Hou Jing rebellion, and that Zhongli was held against Wei in 507 by Wei Rui, shows how finely this defensive line was worked after 494. The third is the long duration of the Liangzhou or Hanzhong line: Hanzhong changed hands repeatedly between north and south, there was a battle at Nanyang in 497, and in 503 the Wei army took Yiyang and came close to Liangzhou, which shows that the struggle for Hanzhong and Xiangyang was not an episode but a structural antagonism lasting more than half a century. In the technology of siegecraft, the sieges of these decades also carried the Chinese stone-thrower, battering ram and siege ladder to a more mature position, and from then on the taking of a city relied more on the combination of engines and on the grinding of a siege than on a single action in the open field. Last of all there was the endless coming and going of diplomacy: envoys, trade and talks for peace went on between Qi and Wei even while the two were at arms, and the border line was kept in being by the fact that neither side would bear the cost of a total victory. This condition of fighting without breaking is the basic shape of the Jiang-Huai frontier in the fifth century.
result: 就494年這一場本身而言，結果是僵持而不是勝負。太和十八年北魏的南進在淮南與漢中兩線都沒有取得可以守住的據點：淮南幾度拉鋒又失，瓜步攻而未克；漢中方向的進攻受制於山道與糧秣，未能打開漢中。北魏在瓜步面對建康的既成防勢，又聞京師變亂，最終班師，孝文帝在一年多後病逝於北返途中，改革的重擔落到宣武帝手上；南齊守住了淮南幾處要點，卻付出沿邊城鎮長期屯駐的沉重代價，也沒有能力反攻。戰役的實際遺產在兩條戰線的形態上：北魏學會了深遠並不等於速決，淮南的遠征若無足夠的渡河舟船與穩定糧道便無法成立；南齊則明白邊境不可能靠一次反擊解決，於是把壽陽、歷陽、瓜步、鍾離、義陽串成一條以城池為節點的接力防線。往後數十年，江淮這條線就以這樣的方式維持著：北魏一代代在北方整軍、屯田、改制，南朝一代代修城、築壘、換將，雙方都沒有能力徹底吃掉對方，於是彼此都成了對方軍事制度的範本與壓力來源。
resultEn: For the year 494 itself the result was stalemate rather than victory. On both the Huai and the Hanzhong fronts the southern advance of Northern Wei failed to seize any ground it could hold: in the Huai region the columns pushed forward and were driven back, and Guabu was assaulted but not taken; in the Hanzhong direction the attack was held up by the mountain tracks and by the supply, and Hanzhong did not open. Facing the established defences of Jiankang at Guabu and hearing at the same time of a rising in the capital, the Wei army finally withdrew, and Xiaowen died of illness on the road back a little more than a year later, leaving the burden of reform to Emperor Xuan; Southern Qi held several of its key points in the Huai region, but paid the heavy price of keeping troops permanently in the frontier towns, and was in no position to counterattack. The real legacy of the campaign lay in the shape the two fronts took: Northern Wei learned that reach did not equal speed, and that an expedition toward the Huai could not stand up without enough boats to cross the river and a supply line that held; Southern Qi learned that the border could not be settled by a single counterstroke, and so it strung Zhoushan, Liyang, Guabu, Zhongli and Yiyang into a relay defence whose nodes were cities. For the decades afterwards the Jiang-Huai line was maintained in just this fashion: Northern Wei reorganised its troops, farmed its land and reformed its institutions generation after generation in the north, while the southern dynasties repaired their walls, raised their ramparts and changed their commanders generation after generation in the south. Neither side had the strength to swallow the other entire, and in the end each became at once the model and the pressure on the other's military system.
